verdict.rationale: Missive's own docs mention "AI rules", which implies an in-product AI automation layer that users configure and therefore steer. The changelog also pitches agents triaging new conversations, and a session tab shows what the assistant is doing, which gives some auditability. However, AI-driven auto-labeling or categorization is never described directly, and the triage example relies on external agents connecting over MCP. missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI auto-labeling/categorization, documented surfacing or prioritization of what needs attention, detail on how AI rules are configured and steered, an audit trail specific to AI triage decisions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI triages my inbox for me — auto-labeling, categorizing, and surfacing what needs attention — with behavior I can steer and audit

citations.quote: Your AI rules, saved models, and assistant conversations stay intact
Let an agent triage new conversations against your CRM before you look at them
The session tab now shows what the assistant is up to
Every action within Missive is logged, so you know who did what, and when.
